issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition logical model 2.1.0-pre: root metadata elements are 0..1 primitives/objects; FHIR JSON elements, when present, must have a value/children and ordinary primitive properties are not represented as JSON null. See ViewDefinition JSON representation and HL7 FHIR JSON representation.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe .temp/qa/sof_vd_10_skeptic_probe.py: parse_view_definition() and ViewDefinition.from_dict() accepted present JSON null for resourceType, id, meta, url, version, status, title, and description. Expected: strict JSON parser/from_dict reject present null while direct dataclass None continues to mean omitted metadata.
issues.root_cause: parse_view_definition() used data.get(...) for optional root metadata, erasing absent versus present-null JSON shape before validation.
issues.resolution: Added parser-only _parse_optional_root_metadata() guard and routed resourceType/id/meta/url/version/status/title/description through it before validate_root_metadata_fields(). Direct dataclass None still serializes as absence.
